title: [DEV] AAPSclient occasionally misses downloads
body:
The data is there in NS, but not everything gets downloaded. Sometimes SGVs (entries) are missing. I'm not sure, if it's an AAPS or NS issue.

The particular case in the screenshots/log (TBR missing on the left side) has happened this morning after turning on the AAPSclient device, but in rare cases it can happen during the day, too when the device is on. Missing data won't get backfilled, even if I force close AAPSclient, delete cache and restart NSClient.

AAPS 3.2.0-dev-l 5c34184723-2023.08.30 with NSClientV3+websockets
NS dev v15: [d602de1](https://github.com/nightscout/cgm-remote-monitor/commit/d602de1c474c212ab8f27d17d18ce12d5679c990)
LOG: [Log Export.txt](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/12545451/Log.Export.txt)
